R. to XII, 7</cite> (ref. to Koh. ib. 6) <he>כדו של … על מַבּוּעוֹ וכ׳</he> the (drawing) pitcher of Barukh over the well (of prophecy) of Jeremiah: <he>כדו … על מבועו של ברוך</he> the (pouring) pitcher of Jeremiah over the well (of inspiration) of Barukh; Lam.
